title: CS sprintlet: morning micro-plan and follow-ups
content:
Quick context: sprintlet for today — three focus lanes: QBR prep, renewals triage, support follow-ups. This is a personal scratchpad, messy; copy into Confluence if anything becomes official.

MORNING SNAPSHOT (08:30)
- Coffee. Inbox triage (CS inbox, #cs-accounts).
- Calendar: 09:30 sync with Ravi (renewal prioritization), 11:00 ACME QBR dry-run, 15:00 triage with Support on Kiev integration bug.
- Top metrics to call out in QBR: DAU on ACME workspace +18% (last 90d), avg latency per request 220ms (hosted, last 30d), billing variance -3% MoM after batching changes.
- Quick risk callouts: ACME legal still missing SOC2 addenda; Northbound renewal needs exec push; Novacorp support escalations likely to push timeline.

TOP 3 PRIORITIES (today)
1) ACME QBR: finalize one-slide exec summary + three ask items (see QBR prep below).
2) Renewals triage: identify 2 at-risk accounts and owners + proposed concessions.
3) Support handoffs: ensure Kiev integration ticket has RCA owner assigned and ETA.

ACCOUNTS (short notes)
- ACME Corp (renewal 2026-06-15) — status: green->amber. Need: SOC2 addendum (legal), usage deck for C-level, one pager on latency/cost improvements. Action: send legal reminder + schedule 30m with procurement. Owner: Clara -> Ravi to escalate if no reply by 05/10.
- Northbound Inc (renewal 2026-05-28) — status: amber. Customer reported model hallucination on product descriptions last week. Product PR #6786 referenced. Action: schedule technical deep-dive, propose 3mo pilot on Canary variant. Owner: June Park (cc me).
- Novacorp (renewal 2026-07-03) — status: red (support backlog). Ticket JIRA-4921 reopened. Action: push for interim SLA credit + accelerate private deployment paperwork. Owner: Support lead (Kendall).

QBR PREP (ACME dry-run notes)
- Objective: reassure execs on performance gains + surface asks (pricing & SOC2).
- 1-slide exec summary template: "What we delivered" / "What changed for you" / "Three asks".
- KPIs to show: active seats, requests/min, p50/p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, incident count last quarter.
- Three ask items (prioritized): 1) SOC2 addendum signature (legal) — urgency: high. 2) Expand Dedicated pool commit by 25% for peak season (ops ask). 3) Agree on joint case study post-launch (marketing).
- Dry-run checklist: practice opening (30s), demo of latency dashboard (45s), hand to product for technical deep-dive (2m).
- Slide TODOs: add one screenshot of Console latency trace, include short quote from Solutions eng.

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS (tickets)
- JIRA-4892 (Kiev integration timeout) — current: triage in progress, assigned to Sam. Need owner for RCA and workaround (pref ETA by EOD). Note: customer on Dedicated plan; escalate if no ETA.
- JIRA-4921 (Novacorp model hallucination) — reopened; include model config snapshot + prompt examples. Ask Research to reproduce on staging.
- JIRA-5005 (embedding mismatch) — low priority; add to weekly batch for Optimize recommendations.

COMMUNICATION SNIPPETS (for Slack/email)
- To legal (ACME): "Hi Maddy — quick reminder on SOC2 addendum we discussed. Can we aim to have the signed addendum by 2026-05-14 so we can lock renewed terms? Happy to jump on a quick call. — Clara"
- To Ops (Dedicated expansion): "Heads up — ACME is considering a +25% commit for peak season. Can you confirm lead time for capacity and pricing delta? Need numbers by 05/10."

RISKS & MITIGATIONS
- Risk: SOC2 addendum delay -> mitigation: offer interim contractual language + staged rollout (no PII in logs until signed).
- Risk: Support backlog for Novacorp -> mitigation: propose SLA credit + temporary engineer hours.

NOTES TO SELF (scratch)
- Run through slide 3 examples before 10:30.
- Pull token usage table from billing (report id: billing-2026-04).
- Confirm Chart screenshot: Console -> Queries -> last 90d -> p95 latency.
- Remind product to prepare two short bullets on kernel selection improvements (perf team).

END-OF-DAY WRAP (items to complete before close)
- Send ACME reminder email + calendar invite.
- Update renewal tracker with any change in risk and owner.
- Post meeting notes (if QBR happens) into Confluence under /CS/QBRs/ACME-2026-06.

Free-form brain dump (fragments):
- Might ask for a small discount for Northbound in exchange for a 9-month prepay?
- Check with Solutions Eng about a short live demo that shows KV cache speed-up.
- If SOC2 holds up, prepare comms for marketing on case study timeline.

— end scratch —
